messages:
claire: quick question for the telemetry folks — how should we derive per-route latency SLOs from traces when exporters are doing probabilistic sampling and we only retain 7 days of raw spans for standard accounts?

raj: short answer: we need an enrichment/rollup layer that turns traces into deterministic metrics (histogram buckets, p50/p95 counts) before retention expires. sampling bias must be corrected at export time.

wei: +1. If we do correction at the collector we can emit two signals: (1) sampled-corrected histogram per route, (2) raw-span count for cardinality checks. that keeps the dashboard queries cheap.

marta: practical concern — customers with reserved capacity have full retention but many customers on hosted tier do not. The rollout UX needs to show expected SLO accuracy depending on retention + sample rate. We should avoid a surprise when they flip a rollout and metrics move.

claire: exactly. proposal: when creating a route in Console, show an "SLO confidence" badge computed from retention window + sampler config + span volume. Also surface recommended sampler config (adaptive) and an opt-in to emit corrected histograms.

raj: implementation notes: collector config snippet (OTel) we discussed earlier:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/metrics: {}
processors:
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_percentage: 5
  metric_generation:
    routes_from_spans: true
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [probabilistic_sampler, metric_generation]
      exporters: [otlp/metrics]
```
This runs sampling then expands route-level histograms. The metric_generation processor needs to attach the sample_rate tag for correction.

wei: make sure the pipeline also emits a `_sampled_count` metric so downstream SLO math can re-scale correctly. otherwise p95 will be biased.

marta: UX question — when we change sample rate in Dedicated pools, should we auto-adjust SLO thresholds or mark them stale? My vote: mark as "confidence lowered" and add recommended correction, but do not auto-change thresholds. We don't want silent SLA drift.

claire: agreed. add a gradual rollout: suggest sampler change in dev, run for 24h with double-export to metrics, then promote. Console should show before/after delta preview.

raj: routing/quota angle: if we route traffic to cheaper regions or model variants to save cost, we must tag traces with routing policy id so SLOs can be sliced by routing policy and by customer tier. Otherwise error budgets get muddled.

wei: yep — add `routing_policy_id` and `model_variant` tags to spans and to generated metrics. Also include `route_bucket` for latency bucketing.

marta: alerting — alerts-bot should include the sampling confidence and retention window in the alert payload. Otherwise on-call will chase a missing spike that was actually due to sampling change.

alerts-bot: auto-note: when SLO breach is detected the alert will include fields: `slo_revision`, `sample_rate`, `retention_days`, `route_tags`, `confidence_score`.

claire: performance note: generating histograms for every route could be high-cardinality. we should limit to top-N routes per tenant + wildcard rollups (service.*). default top-N=200, configurable in Console.

raj: fallback for low-retention accounts: approximate SLOs using a combination of request logs (fast) + sampled traces (accurate for tails). add a "hybrid metric" exporter that merges traces and logs.

wei: ops question — how do we backfill when retention increases (customer buys Dedicated)? we can recompute metrics from raw spans if we still have them, otherwise we mark the historic window as 'partial' and run estimations. Console should show a backfill job option.

marta: I'll draft Console UX copy for: SLO confidence badge, rollout preview modal, sampling recommendation tooltip, backfill action. Keep language non-technical for PMs but with an "advanced" view for raw config.

claire: thanks. next steps:
- raj/wei: prototype collector metric_generation + sampled_count emitter (P0)
- marta: mocks for confidence badge + rollout preview (P1)
- infra: add top-N limiter and route tag schema to proto (P1)
- I will write a short doc for SRE on how sampling impacts SLOs (P0)

raj: ack. starting a spike and will post logs here in a follow-up thread.

devops-bot: deploy queued: otel-collector/metric-gen-spike -> staging at 1849501320 (CI build 4621) :package:

marta: leaving notes for product: make sure billing knows that emitting corrected histograms increases metric ingestion and may affect tiers.

claire: good call. tagging finance and growth in the doc. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
